messages:
Sarah (AE): quick heads-up — HelixHealth wants a POC perf run next Wed. Goal: sustain 500 qps, handle 2k burst for 30s, p99 < 300ms for single-turn gen (avg 128 tokens). Need pricing estimate and any enterprise blockers (HSM / VPC). Can we assemble run plan?

Mike (SRE): ping @Sarah (AE) — we can run distributed load across 3 AZs. Need to know model + sequence length distribution. For p99 300ms we'll probably need dedicated instances or quantized model. Also KV cache warm-up matters.

Jamie (Solutions): model we'll use is redwood/open-13b-8bit (as discussed). Workload: mostly single-turn chat, 60% short (<64 tokens), 30% medium (64-256), 10% long (>256).

Mike (SRE): ok. Run outline:
1) smoke (10m, 50 qps)
2) ramp (20m to 500 qps)
3) sustain (1h at 500 qps with 3x 30s microbursts to 2k)
4) tail run (30m low-rate)
We'll capture traces + token-level cost and p95/p99 latency. We'll also record GPU util and KV hit rates.

Jamie (Solutions): sample load command if you want to reproduce locally (k6):

```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  let res = http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model: 'redwood/open-13b-8bit', prompt: '...'}), { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
}
```

Mike (SRE): we'll also run our internal runner that preserves streaming/resume semantics. Plan to try batch sizes [1,8] and KV cache warm vs cold to show variance.

Eli (DevRel): cost ballpark for a 1h sustained 500 qps run (dedicated, 12x A10 equiv): ~$3.2k compute + token costs ~depends on prompt length. I'll produce a short spreadsheet. If they want Reserved/Dedicated pricing we can give a monthly commit option.

Sarah (AE): procurement will want a one-pager with scope + risks. Top risks: HSM integration, private VPC setup time, and long tail latency on cold KV misses.

Mike (SRE): noted. Action items:
- Mike: build run script + metrics dashboard
- Jamie: prepare model config + prompt set
- Eli: cost spreadsheet + procurement one-pager
- Sarah: confirm run window with HelixHealth

Jamie (Solutions): quick checklist for the run:
- prompt set (2000 samples)
- golden answers for quality spot checks
- A/B toggles for batching/quantization
- network egress baseline

Sarah (AE): can someone also confirm whether customer requires HSM-backed keys? that's usually a 2-3 week blocker for Private.

Eli (DevRel): @Sarah (AE) if they do require HSM we should flag for early security questionnaire and model-inference on private nodes. Also need to know whether audit logs retention >90d.

Mike (SRE): perf-bot scheduled a dry-run tomorrow at 10:00 to validate harness. If that passes we'll do main run Wed 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: scheduled job id=run-2934-dry, owner=Mike (SRE), window=2026-04-08T10:00:00Z. Logs will appear in /shared/sales/helixhealth/perf/

Sarah (AE): thanks team — I'll confirm with the customer and post their acceptance here.

Jamie (Solutions): :thumbsup: will prep the scripts and prompt sets.
